title: OPTIMA: Optimal One-shot Pruning for LLMs via Quadratic Programming Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2512.13886v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training pruning cuts the inference cost of large language models, yet it faces a trade-off: simple heuristics that zero weights are fast but degrade accuracy, while principled joint optimization methods recover accuracy but are computationally infeasible at modern scale. One-shot methods such as SparseGPT sit in between and apply efficient but approximate weight updates. To close this gap, we introduce OPTIMA, a practical one-shot post-training pruning method that balances accuracy and scalability. OPTIMA casts layer-wise weight reconstruction after mask selection as independent, column-wise quadratic programs (QPs) that share one Hessian per weight matrix. Solving these QPs yields, at solver convergence, the per-column minimizer of the layer-wise reconstruction objective under the shared Hessian, and the shared Hessian makes the QPs easy to batch on accelerators. translated_title: OPTIMA：基于二次规划重构的大语言模型最优一次性剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 训练后剪枝能够降低大语言模型的推理成本，但其面临一个权衡问题：将权重置零的简单启发式方法虽然速度快，却会降低模型精度；而基于原理的联合优化方法虽然能恢复精度，但在现代规模下计算上不可行。SparseGPT等一次性（one-shot）方法介于两者之间，采用高效但近似的权重更新。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了OPTIMA，一种在精度和可扩展性之间取得平衡的实用一次性训练后剪枝方法。OPTIMA将掩码选择后的逐层权重重构问题表述为独立的、按列划分的二次规划问题（QP），这些二次规划在每个权重矩阵上共享同一个Hessian矩阵。在求解器收敛时，求解这些二次规划可以得到共享Hessian下逐层重构目标的逐列最优解，且共享的Hessian矩阵使得这些二次规划问题易于在加速器上进行批量处理。我们实现了一个对加速器友好的QP求解器，该求解器可累积……
tldr: OPTIMA将掩码选择后的逐层权重重构表述为共享单个Hessian矩阵的按列二次规划问题，并借助加速器友好的QP求解器，在大语言模型上同时实现了剪枝的高精度与可扩展性。
en_tdlr: OPTIMA formulates layer-wise weight reconstruction after mask selection as column-wise quadratic programs sharing a single Hessian, and with an accelerator-friendly QP solver, it achieves both accuracy and scalability for one-shot post-training pruning of LLMs.
